note: CENSUS official source registry. Distinct from data/sources.json (evidence provenance for ideas). These are statistical and regulatory datasets used for denominator construction. Source methodology must be read before extracting numbers.

sources.publisher: EUROACE (European Alliance of Companies for Energy Efficiency in Buildings)
sources.unit: ESCO market revenue (EUR), active projects (estimated), member firm count

excluded: Simple energy supply contracts without performance guarantee
public sector internal energy management teams

limitations: Industry association data: coverage biased toward member firms, may undercount smaller ESCOs
Revenue figures, not contract count; contract count requires average project value assumption
Average project value range is wide (EUR 500K-5M) creating 10× uncertainty in implied contract count
sources.notes: Primary source for DOGFOOD A eligible population. Revenue implies contract count but average project value is the binding uncertainty.

sources.dataset: State of the Building Stock / ESCO Project Database
sources.unit: Completed ESCO projects since 2000 (cumulative count, EU)

included: ESCO projects in EU member states
excluded: purely equipment-sale contracts without performance guarantee

limitations: Cumulative count (stock since 2000), not active stock at reference date
Must apply assumed project duration (3-7 years) to derive active stock
Duration assumption creates significant uncertainty in active stock estimate
sources.citation: BPIE (2023). State of the EU Building Stock.
sources.notes: COUNTER-ESTIMATE source for DOGFOOD A. 35,000+ cumulative projects / assumed 5-year duration ≈ 7,000 active. Consistent with EUROACE bottom-up range.

sources.unit: Employer enterprises by NACE activity and size class (number of employees)

included: Employer enterprises with at least one paid employee
excluded: Non-employer enterprises (self-employed sole traders with no employees)
Agriculture, forestry and fishing (NACE A) — handled separately
Financial services (NACE K) — separate FINREP/SHS statistics

limitations: Employer enterprises only — nonemployers excluded; if sole-trader ESCOs exist, they are missed
Size class by employee count, not revenue — some ESCOs may be small in employees but large in revenue
NACE primary activity classification: diversified conglomerates may be misclassified
Some small-country cells suppressed for confidentiality
sources.citation: Eurostat (2024). Structural Business Statistics, table sbs_sc_ovw, reference year 2022.
sources.notes: Primary denominator source for DOGFOOD B (manufacturing enterprises by size) and DOGFOOD C (energy-intensive industry enterprises). WARNING: counts employer enterprises, not EPC engagements, not procurement events. Unit conversion required.

sources.publisher: ENTSO-E (European Network of Transmission System Operators for Electricity)
sources.dataset: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform — Balancing energy activated
sources.unit: Activated balancing energy volumes (MWh) by product, country, period; Balancing Service Provider (BSP) registrations

excluded: DSO-managed local flexibility markets (separate, not consolidated here)

limitations: Volume data (MWh) published, not site count — must apply assumed average site capacity to derive site count
BSP registration data available but aggregated — individual site count requires download and processing
DSO flexibility markets excluded — likely significant and growing but not captured here
Average site capacity assumption (1-5 MW) creates 5× uncertainty in site count
sources.citation: ENTSO-E (2025). Transparency Platform, Balancing Energy Activated, 2024.
sources.notes: Primary source for DOGFOOD C site count and event volume. Download BSP registration table directly. Volume / assumed site capacity = lower bound on enrolled sites.

sources.publisher: ACER (Agency for the Cooperation of Energy Regulators)
sources.dataset: ACER Market Monitoring Report 2024 — Wholesale electricity and gas markets
sources.unit: Market structure: aggregator counts, flexibility volumes, capacity market participation

excluded: non-EU EEA countries (Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein) unless noted

limitations: Aggregator count is approximate — no binding EU-wide registry
Country-level granularity varies; some markets (Germany FCR) better documented than others (some Eastern EU states)
sources.notes: COUNTER-ESTIMATE source for DOGFOOD C. Provides aggregator count (~200+) which cross-validates ENTSO-E site count via sites/aggregator assumption.
